howIWork.metaDescription: Engagement model, who it's for, and what a typical 3-month engagement looks like.
howIWork.title: How I work
howIWork.intro: A focused engagement, with dedicated time and real attention.
model: 8 hours per month of hands-on technical work + 2 follow-up calls
for: Startups of 5–50 people without a CTO
Technical founders who can no longer do everything
Teams with product in production but without clear technical direction
Companies that need to audit their architecture before scaling
notFor: Projects that need a full development team (→ I refer to my consultancy)
Companies looking for an advisor without execution
Unvalidated ideas that need an MVP (→ I can refer you)

about.metaDescription: 16 years in software engineering, two agencies, and a focus on regulated industries.
about.title: About
paragraphs: I've been building software for 16 years. I've founded two agencies (2014–2017 and 2021–2025), and I'm currently Staff Engineer and Head of Engineering at Nolte, a US software consultancy.
I specialize in regulated industries: insurtech, healthtech, and fintech. It's the place where technical decisions have real consequences and where code quality matters more than raw speed.
I live in Puebla, Mexico, with my wife and our three kids. When I'm not on a call, I'm rowing, playing guitar, or training for a half marathon.
